name: banking-app
description: Mangaud Banking Console - MERN Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run start:client:lan"
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build

author: Mangaud Banking
